chronology.status: frozen before implementation, fitting, or result-producing execution

membership.identity_rule: the training_cells and holdout_cells arrays are loaded byte-for-byte from the base config

anchor_model.domain: exact dtype, operation and ranks on a fully intra-node collective
anchor_model.exact_rule: return an exact same-operation, same-rank and same-byte training anchor unchanged
anchor_model.paired_operation_rule: when the complementary operation has an exact same-rank and same-byte training anchor, multiply it by the ratio of requested-operation and complementary-operation affine training-only trends at that byte count
anchor_model.fallback_rule: affine latency interpolation on true bytes between adjacent same-operation and same-rank training anchors
anchor_model.lower_extrapolation: affine latency extrapolation from the two smallest same-curve training anchors
anchor_model.upper_extrapolation: affine latency extrapolation from the two largest same-curve training anchors
anchor_model.holdout_use: none during construction; Family H is loaded only after the serialized authority hash exists
anchor_model.transition_prior_disposition: the GH200 width-2 dip is not used because the H200 misses do not form one transition cluster

family_h.band: relative error no greater than max(0.10, two H200 GPU cycles divided by measured completion)

family_d8.mechanism_hypothesis: broad positive floor-plus-slope regimes bias the two rank-8 operation neighborhoods; the exact-domain anchor form removes that approximation without a D8-specific term

packet_cells.error_band: relative error no greater than max(0.10, two H200 GPU cycles divided by matched observed phase completion)
required_mechanisms: explicit traffic class and virtual channel
NVSwitch input ports and virtual output queues
packet_cells.feasibility_rule: do not execute or score when current evidence cannot independently identify the product parameters or the prerequisite mechanism structure is absent

preservation.legacy_transfer_rule: all existing positive floor-plus-slope regimes and published donor queries remain byte-identical
